taxonomy.description: Repeated, rapid failed authentication attempts from a single or distributed sources targeting one or more entities.
An authenticated entity attempting to access an unusual sequence of high-privilege resources across the network.
Access attempts from an entity utilizing a significantly altered or previously unseen device fingerprint.
Geographical access points that are physically impossible to traverse within the recorded timeframe.

behavioral_assumptions.normal: Entities operate within predictable working hours, originating from standard geographical regions, interacting with a steady subset of resources.
behavioral_assumptions.anomalous: Deviations in volume, velocity, sequence of commands, or geospatial attributes indicate compromised credentials or insider threats.
